newsitem.title: ITALY: Min rate 6.95 pct at Bank of Italy BOT buyback.
newsitem.headline: Min rate 6.95 pct at Bank of Italy BOT buyback.

text.p: The minimum rate at today's Bank of Italy offer to buyback up to 2.0 trillion lire of short-term bills (BOT) stood at 6.95 percent.
The average rate was 7.04 percent. The offer, which was fully taken up, takes effect today.
At the last Bot buyback on October 14, the minimum rate was 7.51 percent and the average rate 7.64 percent.
The Bank said it received 13 bids of which 10 were met in full and one in part.
